mapper.insert: INSERT INTO performance_issue (issue_type, app_name, title, evidence_json, source_repo_id, source_file_id, line_start, line_end, root_cause, stress_task_id, status) VALUES (#{issueType}, #{appName}, #{title}, #{evidenceJson}, #{sourceRepoId}, #{sourceFileId}, #{lineStart}, #{lineEnd}, #{rootCause}, #{stressTaskId}, 'pending')
mapper.update: UPDATE performance_issue SET root_cause = #{rootCause}, status = 'analyzed' WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE performance_issue SET evidence_json = #{evidenceJson} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE performance_issue SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE performance_issue SET stress_task_id = #{stressTaskId} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.sql: id, issue_type, app_name, title, evidence_json, source_repo_id, source_file_id, line_start, line_end, root_cause, status, stress_task_id, verify_json, verify_time, create_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM performance_issue WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
